svg.title: Workflow 4: Invoices out the day the job ends
svg.text: Invoices out the day the job ends
No batching, no AI: the job’s own record becomes the invoice, and paying takes one tap.
Same day, with Pay by bank and
Stripe; marked paid in Xero by itself
Unpaid after due date only. A payment stops every reminder.
13 weeks: job → invoice median same day (was 6 days). 71% of homeowner invoices paid within 3 days. Debtor days 41 → 27.
Over-60-day debt £23.8k → £6.9k. Google reviews 64 → 111: homeowners get a review request 2 days after paying.
Uses AI anywhere in the money
Sets VAT or CIS: Xero’s settings, agreed
Chases a customer twice the same day
Agents get one monthly statement, as they
Stops reminders the moment money lands
Sync fails: Xero shows it, Lisa sends it by
Daily check: every completed job has an
Xero reminders + Stripe Pay by bank
n8n for the checks and texts
